from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/inputs/providers.py')
old = 'model calls are off; set SKILLC_ALLOW_MODEL_CALLS=1 for a deliberate run'
new = 'model calls are disabled; opt in explicitly before running a model'
text = p.read_text()
if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError(f'expected exactly one match, found {text.count(old)}')
updated = text.replace(old, new, 1)
try:
    with p.open('w') as f:
        f.write(updated)
except Exception as exc:
    print(f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
    raise
